scripts.title: AutoCollect & AutoClick
scripts.script:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

if _G.AutoClickerRunId then
	_G.AutoClickerRunId += 1
else
	_G.AutoClickerRunId = 1
end
local myRun = _G.AutoClickerRunId

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("AutoClickerGUI")
if old then
	old:Destroy()
end

local function tycoonNameOfClicker(clicker: Instance): string
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return clicker.Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.Name
	end)
	if ok and res then
		return res
	end
	return "?"
end

local function tycoonNameOfGiver(giver: Instance): string
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return giver.Parent.Parent.Name
	end)
	if ok and res then
		return res
	end
	return "?"
end

local function collectClickers()
	local found = {}
	local tyRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
	if not tyRoot then
		return found
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return tyRoot:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return found
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		if d:IsA("ClickDetector") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Clicker" then
			local model = d.Parent.Parent
			local mine = model and model.Parent
			if model and model.Name == "Model" and mine then
				table.insert(found, {
					clicker = d.Parent,
					detector = d,
					model = model,
					mine = mine,
					tycoon = tycoonNameOfClicker(d.Parent),
				})
				if #found >= 50 then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local function collectGivers()
	local found = {}
	local tyRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
	if not tyRoot then
		return found
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return tyRoot:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return found
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == "Giver" and d:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then
			table.insert(found, {
				part = d,
				tycoon = tycoonNameOfGiver(d),
			})
			if #found >= 50 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local entries = collectClickers()
local givers = collectGivers()

local KEYWORDS = { "click", "mine", "drop", "upgrade", "tycoon", "speed", "button", "ore" }

local function nameMatches(n: string): boolean
	local l = string.lower(n)
	for _, k in ipairs(KEYWORDS) do
		if string.find(l, k, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local allRemotes: any = {}
local seen: any = {}
local function addRemote(r: any)
	if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") and not seen[r] then
		seen[r] = true
		table.insert(allRemotes, r)
	end
end

local function scanRoot(root: any, cap: number, onlyMatching: boolean)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return root:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		n += 1
		if n > cap then
			break
		end
		if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			if not onlyMatching or nameMatches(d.Name) then
				addRemote(d)
			end
			if #allRemotes >= 25 then
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
	scanRoot(e.clicker, 50, false)
	scanRoot(e.model, 100, false)
	scanRoot(e.mine, 200, false)
end
scanRoot(ReplicatedStorage, 2000, true)

local hasFireClick = (typeof(fireclickdetector) == "function")
local hasFireTouch = (typeof(firetouchinterest) == "function")

local clickNames: any = {}
for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
	table.insert(clickNames, e.tycoon)
end
print("[AutoClicker] Click tycoons (" .. tostring(#entries) .. "): " .. table.concat(clickNames, ", "))
local giverNames: any = {}
for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
	table.insert(giverNames, g.tycoon .. "=" .. g.part:GetFullName())
end
print("[AutoClicker] Money givers (" .. tostring(#givers) .. "): " .. table.concat(giverNames, " | "))
if #entries == 0 then
	warn("[AutoClicker] No ClickDetectors found under workspace.Tycoons.")
end
if #givers == 0 then
	warn("[AutoClicker] No Giver+Attachment parts found under workspace.Tycoons.")
end
if not hasFireClick then
	warn("[AutoClicker] fireclickdetector() missing in Studio. Remote fallback will be used.")
end
if not hasFireTouch then
	warn("[AutoClicker] firetouchinterest() missing in Studio. Collect falls back to teleporting your character.")
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AutoClickerGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 196)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.3, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local dragBar = Instance.new("TextLabel")
dragBar.Name = "DragBar"
dragBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
dragBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
dragBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
dragBar.Text = "DRAG HERE"
dragBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
dragBar.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
dragBar.TextSize = 13
dragBar.Active = true
dragBar.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: OFF"
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
toggleBtn.TextSize = 16
toggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
toggleBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

local collectBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
collectBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44)
collectBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 80)
collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
collectBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: OFF"
collectBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
collectBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
collectBtn.TextSize = 16
collectBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
collectBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local collectCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
collectCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
collectCorner.Parent = collectBtn

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 35)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 18
closeBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 62)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 128)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
statusLabel.TextSize = 12
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
statusLabel.TextWrapped = true
statusLabel.Text = "starting..."
statusLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local enabled = false
local collectEnabled = false
local dragging = false
local dragStart = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local startPos = mainFrame.Position
local fires = 0
local collects = 0
local connections = {}

local function refreshStatus()
	local methodText = "NONE"
	if hasFireClick and #allRemotes > 0 then
		methodText = "fireclick+" .. tostring(#allRemotes) .. " remote(s)"
	elseif hasFireClick then
		methodText = "fireclick"
	elseif #allRemotes > 0 then
		methodText = tostring(#allRemotes) .. " remote(s)"
	end
	local touchText = if hasFireTouch then "invisible" else "teleport"
	statusLabel.Text = "Clickers: " .. tostring(#entries) .. " | " .. methodText .. "\nMoneyGivers: " .. tostring(#givers) .. " (" .. touchText .. ") | Fires: " .. tostring(fires) .. " | Collects: " .. tostring(collects)
end
refreshStatus()

local function cleanup()
	enabled = false
	collectEnabled = false
	dragging = false
	_G.AutoClickerRunId += 1
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	screenGui:Destroy()
	collectgarbage("collect")
end

table.insert(connections, dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled
	if enabled then
		toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: ON"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 85)
	else
		toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: OFF"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
	refreshStatus()
end))

table.insert(connections, collectBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	collectEnabled = not collectEnabled
	if collectEnabled then
		collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: ON"
		collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 200)
	else
		collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: OFF"
		collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
	refreshStatus()
end))

table.insert(connections, closeBtn.Activated:Connect(cleanup))

local function doCollectAll()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	if hasFireTouch then
		for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
			if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId or not collectEnabled then
				break
			end
			pcall(function()
				firetouchinterest(hrp, g.part, 0)
				task.wait()
				firetouchinterest(hrp, g.part, 1)
			end)
		end
	else
		local saved: CFrame = hrp.CFrame
		for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
			if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId or not collectEnabled then
				break
			end
			pcall(function()
				hrp.CFrame = g.part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end)
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		pcall(function()
			hrp.CFrame = saved
		end)
	end
	collects += 1
	refreshStatus()
end

task.spawn(function()
	while myRun == _G.AutoClickerRunId do
		if collectEnabled and #givers > 0 then
			pcall(doCollectAll)
		end
		local waited = 0
		while waited < 5 and myRun == _G.AutoClickerRunId do
			task.wait(0.1)
			waited += 0.1
		end
	end
end)

local hbConn
hbConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId then
		pcall(function()
			hbConn:Disconnect()
		end)
		return
	end
	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	fires += 1
	if hasFireClick then
		for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
			pcall(fireclickdetector, e.detector)
		end
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(allRemotes) do
		pcall(function()
			r:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	if fires % 15 == 0 then
		refreshStatus()
	end
end)
table.insert(connections, hbConn)
